turns.question: What drove dropping per-user records kept by our backend in favour of signed credentials?
turns.text:
DB load drove it. Issue #11 reported that the sessions table was hot, with p95 DB CPU hitting 90% at login peaks [1]. PR #1 ("switch sessions to JWT") then replaced server-side sessions with short-lived JWTs because the session table was the main source of DB load [2]. Refresh tokens stay server-side [2]. The Auth design doc records the same decision: 15-minute JWTs plus server-side refresh tokens, made in #1 after #11 [3].

A later side effect: PR #6 fixed a login redirect loop that happened when a JWT expired mid-session [4].
